text: Bitcoin's 2.1% gain outpacing Ethereum's 1.3% reflects risk-off positioning, with BTC dominance at 56.8% showing capital flowing toward the perceived safer major asset even as extreme fear persists. The modest $70B volume paired with extreme fear (25) and a rising Fear & Greed trend suggests shallow conviction—buyers are testing lows, but the rally lacks broad participation across altcoins, which are nearly flat. This pattern typically marks capitulation bottoms where weak hands have mostly exited, though sustained recovery would need volume and sentiment to improve together.
